name: BSP_FrontEndScreens_RecomputeRequests
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet front_end_screen_sets, read-only analysis. __cdecl(void), RET, 60h byte frame. The only writer of the requested byte screen+4h outside the screens themselves. 004F7627 clears a 5Fh-byte stack bitmap, one byte per registry slot; 004F7638 sets the occlusion floor 00E08310 to 1; 004F7642 walks the five level vectors from 00E18D38 (level 5) down to 00E18CF8 (level 1) with ESI -= 10h and EBX the level. Per id: screen = [00E18B60 + id*4], skipped when null; at 004F7689, while EBX is above the floor, the screen virtual +8h is asked and a true raises the floor to EBX, so the first opaque screen in a level decides for that level; 004F76A2 ORs (EBX >= floor) into the bitmap. Then two separate full sweeps of all 95 slots, 004F76D0 clearing +4h where the bitmap is 0 and 004F7700 setting it where the bitmap is 1, both skipping any screen whose virtual +4h returns true (self-managed visibility). The base vtable 00CEAE54 supplies 004F7570 for +4h and 004F7580 for +8h, both 'xor al,al; ret', so a screen opts in by overriding; no leaf override was identified. 00E08310 outlives the call: BSP_Game_Render compares it against 1 at 004CA521, and 005B5757 reads it too. docs/FRONTEND_SCREEN_SETS.md

name: BSP_PriorityLists_GetTopPopulatedLevel
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __cdecl, no arguments, RET. Five checked vectors of 4-byte elements sit at 00e18cfc, 00e18d0c, 00e18d1c, 00e18d2c and 00e18d3c. The walk starts at the last with a counter of 5, steps back 10h at a time and returns the counter at the first non-empty vector, or 0 once it passes 00e18cfc. 004f7620 walks the same five with the same 1..5 numbering, resolves each element through the object table at &DAT_00e18b60 and latches the highest active level in DAT_00e08310, which fixes the base and the direction. Sole caller is the simulation gate at 004e5196, comparing the result against EDI = 1 with JG. What the levels rank is not established. Evidence: docs/GAME_SIMULATION_GATE.md.

name: BSP_FrontEndScreen_CommitVisibility
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet front_end_screen_sets, read-only analysis. Supersedes the earlier record BSP_FrontEndScreen_n, whose evidence describes this same behaviour under a name that reads as truncated. __thiscall(screen), RET, SEH handler 00C684D8. The screen virtual +24h fills a heap std::vector of child pointers; each non-null child gets its own virtual +34h called with the byte at screen+5h, the APPLIED state, not the requested one; the vector is then freed. The interleaved 00BF6713 calls are _SECURE_SCL range assertions. The base +24h at 004F75D0 is 'ret 4', so a screen with no children commits nothing. 35 callers: the pump 004F8830 calls it on both the exit and the enter pass, BSP_FrontEndScreen_Close 004B6E50 tail-jumps to it, and individual screens call it after writing their own bytes. docs/FRONTEND_SCREEN_SETS.md

name: BSP_FrontEndScreens_SetLevel4Set
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet front_end_screen_sets, read-only analysis. __cdecl varargs (int id, ...), RET, no ECX, SEH handler 00C68558. The list is terminated by a zero id and the terminator is not stored: 004F8737 loads [ESP+28h], 004F8748 walks the argument list from &[ESP+28h] with push_back 004F8480 into a local 16-byte std::vector<int> (+0h iterator-debug head, +4h/+8h/+0Ch first/last/end), then 004F876D assigns it into the level-4 global vector at 00E18D28 through 004F81D0, sets the byte at 00E18CDC and calls the recompute 004F7620, then frees the local buffer. An empty list clears the level, because 004F81D0 with an empty source falls to the erase(begin, end) arm 004F7E80; that is how 00683AA0 and the default arms of the +10h overrides hide everything. The ids are screen registry slots (indices into 00E18B60, 95 slots), not interface ids. One of five level setters: 004F8530 level 1 (00E18CF8), 004F85D0 level 2 (00E18D08), 004F8670 level 3 (00E18D18), this one level 4, 004F87B0 level 5 (00E18D38); the level is baked into the entry point, not passed. Five callers: 00683AA6, 0068593A/0068584F and the other main-menu arms, 0068783E, 0068984B and friends, 004DA9CA. docs/FRONTEND_SCREEN_SETS.md

name: BSP_FrontEndScreens_Pump
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __stdcall(float raw_delta), RET 4, no ECX. Three callers; in GGame::OnMove 004e4ca3 it is the shared tail of states 1, 2 and 4. Guard: the 00425d10 singleton's byte +25Ch (modal dialog) narrows the body to that screen's virtual +20h and then returns unless game+1FE4h (local players) and 00E198C4 (mission) are both set. Otherwise clears the byte at 00E18CDC and makes three full passes over the 95 pointer slots 00E18B60..00E18CDB: exit (wanted==0 && active!=0 -> virtual +1Ch, then if still active clear active and run 004f83b0), enter (wanted!=0 && active==0 -> set active, 004f83b0, virtual +18h), update (both set -> virtual +20h with the raw delta).

name: BSP_Vector3f_Cross
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(out = ECX, a = EDX, b = [ESP+4]), RET 4, and leaves out in EAX, which 00BBD310 relies on when chaining. Standard right-handed cross product: out.x = a.y*b.z - a.z*b.y, out.y = b.x*a.z - a.x*b.z, out.z = b.y*a.x - a.y*b.x. Used twice per axis by the ocean frame step. docs/GAME_WORLD_OCEAN.md. | [BSP reconstruction 004f9b30] Exact camera axis/x87/CRT routing audit: docs/SYSTEM_CAMERA_AXES.md; reports/system_camera_axes_audit.json. New typed interfaces; external actual __87except binding retained; no native ABI or gameplay validation. Descriptive camera names are provisional. Composed system prefix integration: docs/SYSTEM_CONSTANT_BUILDER.md; reports/system_constant_builder_audit.json. Earlier bounded-worker limitations describe the worker snapshot; current root composition uses explicit actual owners and has a new typed ABI, without gameplay validation.
